description: Vewin, the association of Dutch drinking water companies, publishes key figures for the drinking water sector. The key figures page summarises annual production, litres used per person per day, the shares of drinking water from groundwater, surface water and bank filtration, kilometres of mains, staff numbers and the average household price per cubic metre, and offers the annual Kerngegevens Drinkwater publications from 2020 to 2025, tariff overviews from 2021 to 2026, forecasts of drinking water use to 2040, household water use surveys from 2016 and 2021 and the drinking water statistics of 2022. An interactive dashboard shows the development of drinking water use and benchmarks the Dutch drinking water companies on water quality, customer service, environment and finance and efficiency. Coverage is the Netherlands. Access is free online as PDF publications and a dashboard. Caveats: the figures are sector and company aggregates, no licence was stated, and the dashboard did not load from the cloud. Simulation uses: demand projections and network length and cost benchmarks for water supply planning. Related records: SVGW Swiss water supply statistics (data-svgw-swiss-water-supply-statistics), the Water NZ performance review (data-water-nz-national-performance-review) and the Australian urban water performance report (data-bom-national-performance-report-urban-water).
